correctness.rationale: The published fixed-locus criterion gives a fixed point precisely when one exponent multiplicity reaches t+1. Since N=kt, a nonidentity free element must have all k residues t times, hence order k; for composite k its proper nontrivial power cannot be free. At k=p, a group rank r lifts along a splitting of vector spaces, and the vanishing of each nontrivial character Fourier coefficient forces all p^r coordinate character multiplicities to be equal. Conversely balanced arrays are free, with m=t/p^(r−1). The affine label group of translations (splitting changes) and GL_r(F_p) (basis changes) acts freely and exhausts repeated arrays, yielding the factorial count. Independent arithmetic verified counts 840,30,1,280,10 and uniform nonzero evaluation histograms. The cited Chern coefficient [z^5](1+z)^9/(1+3z)^3=−360 and complete-intersection degree 27 yield Euler −1080/9 after étale quotient. Simply connected covering, trivial K by holomorphic Lefschetz and h11=1 justify the fivefold invariants. Geometric criterion is used as a cited theorem, not independently reproved.

originality.rationale: Hidalgo–Hughes–Leyton–Álvarez establish the fixed-point criterion, and Billi–Palomino–Sarti describe fixed-point-free individual automorphisms and cyclic quotients. Hua covers a special four-quadric family including an elementary-abelian group type, not an all-rank labelled count. The uniform Fourier-array classification and exact subgroup embedding census go beyond the inspected prior statements. The closest Billi–Palomino–Sarti 2026 full text could not be accessed through lawful channels; only its abstract is read, so undisclosed subgroup statements remain a substantial priority risk. Qualified PASS on currently inspected material, not a declaration of whole-paper noncoverage.
residual_risks: Full Billi–Palomino–Sarti text, including appendices, was inaccessible: no claim of complete noncoverage is made.
An unstated general Fourier characterization of free diagonal actions in older finite-group-action literature could imply this enumeration.
The theorem is only for fixed coordinate-labelled diagonal group H, not all automorphisms or quotient isomorphism classes.

value.rationale: Classifying all simultaneously free subgroups is stronger than checking single generators and is needed to construct smooth finite étale Calabi–Yau quotients with controlled fundamental group. The sharp p-primary rank bound and exact embedded-subgroup census provide a natural, reusable arithmetic-geometric invariant of the distinguished symmetry group.

final_claim: Free subgroups of the distinguished diagonal group on smooth Calabi–Yau generalized Fermat intersections are absent at composite degree; at prime p they correspond exactly to balanced p^r-character arrays with p^(r−1)|t, have rank at most 1+v_p(t), and their embedded labelled count is (pt)!/[p^r(m!)^(p^r)|GL_r(F_p)|].
